steps: Toast kataifi noodles in oven until golden
Mix toasted noodles with pistachio cream
Chill mixture in fridge to firm up
Melt marshmallow and cocoa on stovetop
Remove from heat to cool slightly
Dip balls in warm marshmallow mixture

hooks: Chewy cocoa shell with creamy center
New dessert texture you need to try
plan.caption: Block 216 Dessert Café introduces our Dubai chewy cookie. A soft marshmallow-cocoa mochi shell wraps around a rich pistachio kataifi filling. Perfect with your latte. #dessert #singapore
